Justin Murphy

Republican candidate for United States Senator, New Jersey · Challenger

Attorney

Justin Murphy is a Burlington County attorney, a Navy veteran and a former deputy mayor and committee member in Tabernacle. He ran for the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate in 2024 and finished third. He won the June 2, 2026 Republican primary with about 33% of the vote and faces incumbent Democrat Cory Booker in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Where Murphy stands

Iran war
Supports continuing the U.S. war with Iran and says President Trump should "finish it" in a positive manner. Argues that the war is needed to keep Iran from getting a nuclear weapon.
Israel and the West Bank
Supports Israel's right to exist. Criticized West Bank settler attacks on Palestinians and said he wants the president to be harder on Israel about settler violence.
Economy and affordability
Blames the Biden administration for some of the country's economic problems and says Trump is working to restore the economy. Points to stock market growth, job gains and rising median incomes.
Taxes and spending
Lists private sector growth, tax cuts and spending reductions as his top priorities.
Immigration and borders
Supports securing the country's northern and southern borders.
Energy
Says he will fight for energy independence and to keep the Jersey Shore free of offshore wind turbines.
Marijuana
Opposes the legalization of recreational marijuana.
